text.en: This Order may be cited as the Excise (Amendment) (No. 2) Order, 2018 and shall commence on the same date as the Maritime and Port Authority of Brunei Darussalam Order, 2017 (S 2212017). Amendment of section 13A of S 4012006

Section 13A of the Excise Order, 2006 is amended, in subsection (l)(b), by deleting "Ports Department" from the second line and by substituting "ports" therefor. Made this 13th. day of Zulkaedah, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of July, 2018 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
